description:
## Empirical signal (2026-05-04)

User-tier POLYBIUS set up a unified polling cron that watches multiple project-tier bw stores for content tagged for cross-tier coordination. But the PROJECT-TIER POLYBIUS instances did not know to flag content for user-tier POLYBIUS — the convention was conveyed inconsistently in per-engagement relay files.

PRINCIPAL flagged: 'Do all the sub agents know to report to you?'

Inconsistent state at flag-time:
- Sub-project POLYBIUS_ariadne_core — relay file did include the convention
- Workspace POLYBIUS_ariadne_core_workspace — relay file did NOT include the convention (told them to surface to PRINCIPAL for everything)
- POLYBIUS_the_stoa — minimal activation paste; convention not conveyed at all

## The convention

When a project-tier or sub-project POLYBIUS needs cross-project context, empirical anchors from another project, or sanity checks that benefit from user-tier visibility, they post a comment on a relevant ticket in their OWN bw (downward-write boundary per stoa--blg) prefixed with a tag like '[for: user-tier POLYBIUS]'. User-tier POLYBIUS polls these stores via unified poll cron (per stoa--cc0) and responds via comment on the same ticket within ~5 min.

PRINCIPAL is exception-handler:
- Project-direction calls → PRINCIPAL
- Ship/no-ship decisions for substantial public-facing work → PRINCIPAL
- Strategic seat input (cross-project priority, ambiguous user preference) → PRINCIPAL
- Cross-project context, empirical anchors, sanity checks → user-tier POLYBIUS via [for:] tag
- Routine technical/operational decisions → handle themselves

This convention belongs in substrate so EVERY POLYBIUS instance inherits the routing model on activation, regardless of whether the activation paste includes it explicitly.

## Where in substrate

1. **MAJOR_POLYBIUS §3 (What you don't do)** — currently enumerates anti-routing-to-PRINCIPAL discipline (§3 Principal-as-router antipattern). Extend to include the alternate routing target: 'When you need cross-project context that PRINCIPAL would not be the right seat for, post a comment on a relevant ticket in your own bw with the [for: user-tier POLYBIUS] tag. User-tier POLYBIUS reads via unified poll cron and responds. This is the cross-tier-coordination-meets-in-lower-tier pattern (§7.1 + stoa--blg).'

2. **MAJOR_POLYBIUS §7.1 (Beadwork visibility)** — the asymmetric visibility section. Add: 'When you need to reach the seat above you (typically user-tier POLYBIUS for project-tier; project-tier POLYBIUS for sub-project), the convention is to post on a ticket in your own bw with a [for: <seat>] flag. The upper seat polls down (per stoa--cc0 unified poll). You never write upward.'

3. **operating-disciplines.md** — universal team protocol. Add a 'Cross-tier coordination routing' section.

4. **substrate/templates/paste-instruction-template.md** — add a section that the activation paste-instruction should include or reference: 'For cross-project context, post [for: user-tier POLYBIUS] on relevant tickets in your own bw.'

## Sibling concerns (POLYBIUS-pair coordination protocol family)

- stoa--vz9 (operating disciplines, landed)
- stoa--ivc (radio-check pattern)
- stoa--ay1 (adaptive polling cadence)
- stoa--blg (cross-tier write boundaries)
- stoa--xh2 (activation paste filename divergence)
- stoa--m5m (positive-references-only directive discipline)
- stoa--0mr (bw storage model + detection)
- stoa--cc0 (unified polling pattern)
- THIS TICKET (cross-tier coordination routing)

All belong in arc-21. POLYBIUS_the_stoa should bundle them.

## Reference

- ariadne--vyo (workspace POLYBIUS active ticket where convention was patched in 2026-05-04)
- stoa--cc0 (the-stoa POLYBIUS active reading where convention was patched in 2026-05-04)
- ariadne-core/HUMAN_relay_subproject_1of_and_xft4_2026-05-04.md (sub-project POLYBIUS got the convention via relay file, demonstrating it's possible to convey)
- ariadne-core-workspace/HUMAN_relay_workspace_phase_b_and_vyo_audit_2026-05-04.md (workspace POLYBIUS DIDN'T get the convention via relay file, demonstrating the gap)
title: Coordination-with-user-tier-POLYBIUS convention should be inherited from substrate, not patched per-engagement
